heading: When to use each
text:
### When to use each [LNLS.2.5]

| Goal | Dialect | Overrides |
|---|---|---|
| Hard RT, no language restrictions beyond the constant-space gate | `realtime` | — |
| Hard RT with N_max-independent join costs | `realtime` | `linear_scan: false` |
| Non-RT with O(1) join guarantee at any scale | `default` | `linear_scan: false` |
| Maximum performance, no RT lifecycle required | `default` | `linear_scan: false` |
| Tightest possible T_wcet and all guarantees | `realtime` | `linear_scan: false` |

The rows that use the `realtime` dialect are deferred with it, and the
compiler refuses them in this edition ([LCAP.2.1.5]).
